g.text: Six-Level Evidence Hierarchy for Causal Claim Validation
Each level is a falsification gate; failure at any level downgrades the evidence grade
UVMR (unclumped IVW): Does a raw genetic signal exist? Screening only.
Clumped UVMR + MRlap + CAUSE: Does it survive instrument-independence and overlap?
LDSC rg + Colocalization: Genome-wide shared polygenic or locus-specific sharing?
MVMR: Does the effect persist after multivariate confounder adjustment?
Two-step MR: Is there a genetically proxied protein/metabolite pathway?
Quantitative scoring: 0/1/2 per level, 0–12 total → Grade D(0-3), C(4-6), B(7-9), A(10-12)
